newsitem.title: USA: Muni yields fall slightly over past week - Delphis.
newsitem.headline: Muni yields fall slightly over past week - Delphis.

text.p: Municipal bond yields were flat to down five basis points in the week ended Thursday, Delphis Hanover Corp said on Friday.
Thirty-year, Aaa-rated municipal yields fell five basis points to 5.60 percent, while thirty-year Baa yields remained unchanged at 6.35 percent.
The small gains kept pace with the Treasury market, where the long bond fell five basis points over the same period to finish Thursday's session at 6.84 percent.
Once again, however, a surprise result on the monthly jobs data Friday sparked a sharp market move. The long bond rallied another nine basis points by mid-morning, lowering the yield to 6.75 percent.

In the intermediate sector of the municipal market, ten-year Aaa-rated muni yields were five basis points lower for the week at 4.95 percent, and Baa-rated 10-years fell the same amount to 5.75 percent.
Average yields on one-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds dropped five basis points to 3.70 percent and Baa-rated one-years fell five to 4.50 percent.
The Aaa municipal yield curve was unchanged at 190 basis points. The spread between one-year and 30-year Baa's widened five basis points to 185 basis points.
The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years was unchanged at 80 basis points, and the 30-year spread widened five to 75 basis points.
